rationale: The assistant reasonably identified the heater or thermal cut-out as suspect, but it dismissed the significance of the interrupted cycle and repeated the same visual-inspection steps. It also pushed the customer to buy parts without a continuity test, and gave specific part numbers for the model without verification, which is likely fabricated. It did suggest a cheap multimeter or an engineer, and it did not tell the customer to bypass the cut-out, but its calibration was poor overall.
